title: Does Latent Chain-of-Thought Actually Reason? A Single, Unifying Taxonomy for Latent Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2610.21182v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Latent chain-of-thought replaces written reasoning steps with continuous hidden states, giving models additional steps to compute before answering. It remains unclear what computation these steps actually perform. High task accuracy and decodable intermediate answers do not establish that a model uses its latent chain to reach an answer. We study this question across twenty-one model-task configurations covering three training recipes, three reasoning tasks, and two backbones. We combine chain deletion and content replacement with probes and trajectory analysis to test whether the chain affects the answer, what it encodes, and how its states change. On logical tasks, COCONUT often carries an answer that is already readable before the chain begins. Its states settle early, and deleting the chain leaves predictions almost unchanged. Per-step supervision produces an ordered layout of reasoning steps and can make the model depend on the chai

translated_title: 潜在思维链真的在推理吗？一个统一的潜在推理分类框架
translated_abstract: 潜在思维链（latent chain-of-thought）用连续的隐藏状态替代书面的推理步骤，使模型在给出答案之前拥有额外的计算步骤。然而这些步骤究竟执行了什么样的计算，目前仍不清楚。高任务准确率和可解码的中间答案并不能证明模型是通过其潜在链得出答案的。我们在二十一个模型-任务配置上研究这一问题，涵盖三种训练方案、三种推理任务和两个骨干网络。我们将链删除和内容替换与探针及轨迹分析相结合，以检验链是否影响答案、它编码了什么内容，以及其状态如何随时间变化。在逻辑任务上，COCONUT 所携带的答案往往在链开始之前就已经是可读取的；其状态早早趋于稳定，删除链后预测几乎不变。逐步监督则会产生有序的推理步骤布局，并可能使模型依赖于链……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一个统一的潜在推理分类框架，通过对21个模型-任务配置进行链删除、内容替换、探针与轨迹分析，发现潜在思维链（如COCONUT）在逻辑任务上往往并未真正执行推理——答案在链开始前已可读取、删除链后预测几乎不变。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a single, unifying taxonomy for latent reasoning and, through chain deletion, content replacement, probes, and trajectory analysis across 21 model-task configurations, shows that latent chains-of-thought (e.g., COCONUT) often do not actually reason on logical tasks—the answer is readable before the chain begins, and deleting the chain barely changes predictions.
